ABSOLUTE CINEMA. ggs to Nemiga for sure!

Incredibly entertaining series and absolutely incredible performance by TDK!!!! I'm so proud of this team!!!! They all played beautifully and all had moments where they were shining! Shame about all the tech pauses during the series for both teams but I'm glad no one had to ff or get subbed :D

Nemiga are a really solid t2 team, and to see them get stomped like that on d2 and overpass is insane. TDK just came out swinging and didn't stop.
